title: hextory.variable_resolver@0.1
description: Language-neutral input/output contract for VariableResolverPort (DES-0008 first slice). A document is exactly one of: resolve_request, resolve_success, resolve_failure. Grammar: {{identifier}} with identifier = [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; '\{{' yields a literal '{{'; unmatched '}}' is left as-is; any other unescaped '{{' fails closed (invalid_bind). Precedence: flow > env > defaults. Only top-level string fields resolve; other values pass through unchanged.

identifier.description: DES-0008-B variable name. Flat names only in @0.1 (no dotted / path binds).

vars_map.description: Variable name -> JSON-compatible value. Non-string values render into templates as canonical compact JSON (sorted keys, no spaces).

fields.description: Station input fields (node field templates). Only top-level string values are resolved; the reserved key 'vars' and '_'-prefixed keys are not station inputs when resolving a traveler payload.

env_profile.description: Environment profile id loaded by the adapter. Omitted/null -> empty Environment; present but unknown -> env_profile_not_found (fail closed).

secret_names.description: Names whose values are secret-backed. Their raw values may appear only in resolved fields; snapshots and errors show the redaction marker.

vars.description: Effective-map snapshot as stored under traveler payload["vars"] (DES-0008-E). Secret values are replaced by the redaction marker.

resolve_error.description: Deterministic structured failure (DES-0008-D). Name lists are sorted and de-duplicated; invalid_binds keep first-occurrence order. Never contains raw secret values.

snippet.description: Redacted excerpt of the first failing template, prefixed by '<field>: ' when produced from fields.
